get.description: Lists all active applications configured for a tenant. The endpoint gets each application’s ZDX Score (default for the previous 2 hours), most impacted location, and the total number of users impacted. To learn more, see Monitoring the Performance Dashboard.

200.description: Successful Operation. The response contains the ZDX Score, most impacted location details, and total users impacted for each application.

name.description: The application name (for example, Salesforce, Sharepoint, etc.).

get.description: Gets the application’s ZDX Score (for the previous 2 hours), most impacted locations, and the total number of users impacted. To learn more, see About the ZDX Score.
Gets the application’s ZDX Score trend. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the previous 2 hours.

Gets the application’s metric trend.

For Web Probes, you can access Page Fetch Time, Server Response Time, DNS Time or Availability. If metrics are not specified, it defaults to Page Fetch Time (PFT).

For Cloud Path probes, you can access latency metrics for End to End, Client - Egress, Egress - Application, Service Edge for Internet & Access - Egress, and Service Edge for Internet & Access - Application. If latency metric is not specified, it defaults to End to End latency. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the previous 2 hours.

Gets the list of all users and their devices that were used to access an application. The endpoint allows to get the list of users based on the score category (i.e., Poor, Okay, or Good), location, department, or geoloaction. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the previouss 2 hours.

email.description: The email address of the user.

score.description: The ZDX Score for the user.

next_offset.description: This value must be entered in the next request to get the next batch from the list.

email.description: The email address of the user.

next_offset.description: This value must be entered in the next request to get the next batch from the list.

get.description: Gets the list of active users along with their devices, active geolocations, and Zscaler locations, filtered by the configured geolocation provider. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the previous 2 hours. The limit is 1000.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of items returned per request from the list. The maximum allowed value for this endpoint is 1000.

email.description: The email address of the user.

next_offset.description: This value must be entered in the next request to get the next batch from the list.

400.description: Bad Request. For example, the limit exceeds the maximum allowed value of 1000.

get.description: Get the location details for a specific user (e.g., device information, active geolocations, associated Zscaler location). If the time range is not specified, the default time range is the previous 2 hours.

email.description: The email address of the user.

404.description: The user ID provided in the request is invalid.

get.description: Gets the list of all active devices and its basic details. The JSON must contain the user’s ID and email address to associate the device to the user. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the previous 2 hours.

next_offset.description: This value must be entered in the next request to get the next batch from the list.

get.description: Gets the device details including the device model information, tunnel type, network, and software details. The JSON must contain the user ID and email address to associate the device to a user. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the previous 2 hours.
Gets the list all active applications for a device. The endpoint gets the ZDX Score each application. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the previous 2 hours.

score.description: The ZDX Score of the application.

get.description: Gets the application’s ZDX Score trend for a device. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the previous 2 hours.
Gets the list of all active web probes on a device. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the previous 2 hours.

avg_pft.description: The average page fetch time in milliseconds.

get.description: Gets the list of all active Cloud Path probes on a device. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the previous 2 hours.

leg_src.description: The leg source (client, egress, zen, connector, etc.).

leg_dst.description: The leg destination (egress, zen, destination, etc.)

get.description: Gets the Web probe metrics trend on a device for an application. For Web probes, you can access Page Fetch Time, Server Response Time, DNS Time, or Availability. If metrics are not specified, it defaults to Page Fetch Time (PFT). If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the previous 2 hours.

Gets the Cloud Path probe metric trend on a device for an application. For Cloud Path probes, you can access latency metrics for End to End, Client - Egress, Egress - Application, Service Edge for Internet & Access - Egress, and Service Edge for Internet & Access - Application. If metrics are not specified, it defaults to End to End latency. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the previous 2 hours.

Gets the Cloud Path hop data for an application on a specific device. Includes the summary data for the entire path like the total number of hops, packet loss, latency, and tunnel type (if available). It also includes a similar summary of data for each individual hop. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the previous 2 hours.
Gets the Call Quality metric trend for a device for a CQM application. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the previous 2 hours.

Gets the health metrics trend for a device. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the previous 2 hours. The health metrics include CPU, Memory, Disk I/O, Network I/O, Wi-Fi, Network Bandwidth, etc.

Gets the Events metrics trend for a device. If the time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the previous 2 hours. The event metrics include Zscaler, Hardware, Software and Network event changes.

Gets the list of all active geolocations for the time range specified. If time range is not specified, the endpoint defaults to the previous 2 hours. The state and city data is retrieved only for the US.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The search string used to support search by name.

name.description: The name of the parent geolocation.

from.name: from
from.description: The start time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If start time is not entered, returns the data for the previous 2 hours.

to.name: to
to.description: The end time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If end time not entered, returns the data for the previous 2 hours.

locations.name: loc
locations.description: The Zscaler location ID. You can add multiple location IDs.

departments.name: dept
departments.description: The department ID. You can add multiple department IDs.

active_geo.name: geo
active_geo.description: The active geolocation ID. You can add multiple active geolocation IDs.

appid.name: appid
appid.description: The application ID assigned by ZDX. For example, 12 for Microsoft Teams Call Quality.

score_bucket.name: score_bucket
score_bucket.description: The ZDX Score category (i.e., Poor, Okay, or Good).

exclude_locations.name: exclude_loc
exclude_locations.description: The Zscaler location ID to exclude. You can exclude multiple location IDs.

exclude_departments.name: exclude_dept
exclude_departments.description: The department ID to exclude. You can exclude multiple department IDs.

exclude_active_geo.name: exclude_geo
exclude_active_geo.description: The active geolocation ID to exclude. You can exclude multiple active geolocation IDs.

offset.name: offset
offset.description: The next_offset value from the last request. You must enter this value to get the next batch from the list. When the next_offset value becomes null, the list is complete.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: The number of items that must be returned per request from the list.

geo_provider.name: geo_provider
geo_provider.description: The geolocation provider used to resolve device geolocations. You can add multiple providers. When it is not specified, the default is "GOOGLE_API". The allowed values are: "GOOGLE_API", "MAXMIND", and "SYSTEM".

exclude_geo_provider.name: exclude_geo_provider
exclude_geo_provider.description: The geolocation providers to exclude when resolving device geolocations. You can exclude multiple providers. The allowed values are: "GOOGLE_API", "MAXMIND", and "SYSTEM".

private_ipv4.name: private_ipv4
private_ipv4.description: IPv4 Address Filter. It has to be limited to ten IPv4 addresses. Also, IPv4 should be used in conjunction with other filter(s). Conjunction filter(s) include userids, emails, loc, exclude_loc, dept, exclude_dept, geo, exclude_geo, mac_addresses

mac_address.name: mac_address
mac_address.description: MAC Address Filter. Multiple MAC Addresses can be provided.

name.description: The application name (for example, Salesforce, Sharepoint, etc.).

active_devices.description: The number number of active devices.

num_poor.description: The number of users with poor scores.

num_okay.description: The number of users with okay scores.

num_good.description: The number of users with good scores.

metric.description: The name of the metric (for example, PFT).

email.description: The email address of the user.

score.description: The ZDX Score for the user.

hw_type.description: The type of hardware (for example, PC, MAC, etc.)

gpu.description: The graphics processing unit (GPU) in the hardware.

logical_proc.description: The number of logical processor in the CPU.

num_cores.description: The number of cores in the CPU.

ssid.description: The SSID of the Wifi network.

bssid.description: The BSSID of the Wifi network.

os_name.description: The OS name on the device.

os_ver.description: The OS version on the device.

os_build.description: The OS build version on the device.

client_conn_ver.description: The client connector version on the device.

zdx_ver.description: The ZDX version on the device.

leg_src.description: The leg source (client, egress, zen, connector, etc.).

leg_dst.description: The leg destination (egress, zen, destination, etc.).

ip.description: The IP address of the hop.

category.description: The Event category - Zscaler, Network, Software, or Hardware.
